description: This file defines the class Smarty_Internal_Method_RegisterClass, which provides a method to register static PHP classes for use within Smarty templates. It includes method documentation and logic for class registration, including error handling when a class does not exist.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Method_RegisterClass
classes.description: Provides methods to register classes for Smarty templates, enabling PHP class registration within the Smarty templating system.

methods.name: registerClass
methods.description: Registers a PHP class for use in Smarty templates, throwing an exception if the class does not exist.
